cards.imageAlt: Figure 14，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What is shown in the picture?
cards.referenceText: Two aircraft are parking on the apron/taxiway, and the wingtip of one aircraft collided with the rudder of the other aircraft. Many staff members are standing around the aircraft and waiting for trouble removal. It should be an accident of ground strike.
cards.referenceTextZh: 两架飞机正停在机坪/滑行道，一架飞机的翼尖与另一架飞机的方向舵相撞。许多工作人员正站在飞机四周等待事故处理。这是一起地面撞击事故。

cards.audioText: What probably caused the situation in your opinion?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为引发事故的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: In my opinion, on one hand, possibly the pilot was not concentrated when taxiing and did not notice the surrounding traffic. On the other hand, maybe the tower controllers made a mistake. They didn’t advise the crew of the potential collision.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在我看来，一方面，可能是飞行员在滑行中不够专注，没有注意到周围的飞机。另一方面，可能是塔台管制员工作出现错误，没能提示机组潜在的相撞危机。

cards.audioText: How to avoid such kind of accident when taxiing?
cards.audioTextZh: 在滑行时怎样避免类似事故？
cards.referenceText: I think communication is important. We must establish good communication among pilots, controllers and ground staff during flight preparation and operation to avoid similar incidents. Besides, all of the aviation workers should focus on their own job, and being familiar with operational procedure is another important thing. As a pilot, we cannot be too careful in preflight preparation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为沟通很重要，在飞行准备阶段，飞行员、管制员和地面工作人员一定要沟通好，避免类似事故发生。此外，所有民航工作人员应专注于自己的工作，熟悉操作流程也非常重要。作为飞行员，我们在做飞行准备时越仔细越好。

cards.audioText: Has such accident ever happened in your company?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的公司曾经发生过这种事故吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, once a ground vehicle crashed into a plane because of the tiredness of the driver. When it occurred, the driver had been working at the airport for more than fifteen hours, so he was too fatigued to keep a sober mind at the critical moment. We have to conclude that, for flight safety, enough rest must be ensured for every airport personnel.
cards.referenceTextZh: 发生过，有一次地面车辆与飞机相撞，因为司机疲劳驾驶。事故发生前司机已在机场连续工作15小时以上，所以在关键时刻没能保持清醒。不得不说，为保证飞行安全，机场工作人员必须保证足够的休息。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me how to use the rudder on an airplane?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能告诉我飞机的方向舵如何使用吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, of course. The rudder on an airplane must be used together with other controls to turn the aircraft and it controls lateral movement by deflecting air in one direction, and thereby oppositely pushing the tail. The rudder is one of the three basic control surfaces on a winged aircraft and it is generally operated by a pair of foot pedals.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。方向舵需要和其它操纵器共同使用，通过将空气引向一个方向从而相对推动机尾，以此控制横向运动。方向舵是有翼飞机上三个基本操纵面之一，通常由一对脚踏开关来操作。

cards.audioText: What about the ailerons? Are they used to turn the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 那么副翼呢？副翼的作用是让飞机转弯吗？
cards.referenceText: If ailerons are also used in conjunction, they will turn a conventional fixed wing aircraft much more quickly than the use of rudder alone. In addition, the ailerons are used to control the aircraft in roll.
cards.referenceTextZh: 副翼和方向舵协调工作时，传统固定翼飞机的速度会比只使用方向舵更快。此外，副翼能够在横滚时控制飞机。

cards.audioText: What do you know about the effect of wingtip devices on aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道翼尖小翼的作用是什么吗？
cards.referenceText: Wingtip devices are usually intended to improve the efficiency of fixed-wing aircraft. There are several types of wingtip devices, and the intended effect is always to reduce the aircraft’s drag by altering the airflow near the wingtips. They can also improve aircraft handling characteristics and enhance the flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 翼尖小翼通常用来增强固定翼飞机的性能。翼尖小翼分为几种类型，但都是通过改变翼尖附近气流来减少飞机阻力。翼尖小翼同时可以加强飞机的操纵稳定性，提高飞行安全程度。

cards.audioText: What do you know about the wingtip design?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对翼尖的设计有什么了解？
cards.referenceText: Wingtip design usually includes navigation lights, anti-collision strobe lights, landing lights and identification markings. To some extent, wingtips can be an expression of aircraft design style, so their shape may be influenced by marketing considerations as well as by aerodynamic requirements.
cards.referenceTextZh: 翼尖的设计中包括导航灯、防撞闪光灯、着陆灯和识别标志。某种程度上，翼尖是飞机设计风格的体现，所以翼尖的形状受市场的影响，同时也要符合航空动力学的要求。
